notes: «أبي» in «حدثنا أبي» has no name in the text: relation; the Saduq's own father is not identified
«رفعه بإسناده» is a gap in the chain (rule 8): the isnad is raised and its names are not written here
«فروي عنها أنها قالت» gives the saying's source only as the pronoun «عنها»; the names of Amina appear in the story, not in the chain, so the link is a back reference
